searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase three — 34 final revelations the awtsmoos recreates even the plan, so yesterday's certainty can become today's clearer rhyme; awtsmoos.com will make these last revelations guard architecture across time. 1. existing root filenames may already be consumed; root modules should become compatibility facades over new focused folders. 2. the canonical protocol string and version must live in exactly one module. 3. movielayerkind must stay backward compatible while adding richer semantic kinds. 4. a migration must be idempotent when handed current v1 data. 5. migration must clone rather than mutate caller state. 6. validation should produce code/path/message/severity objects while preserving old errors strings for compatibility. 7. movie duration can be arbitrary positive finite seconds. 8. scene overlaps may be legal for compositing, so validator should not wrongly require serial scenes. 9. layer local timing must be bounded by scene duration. 10. parent references must not create obvious self parent cycles. 11. asset/cast references should be warnings when absent only if a semantic placeholder is intentionally allowed; otherwise errors. 12. patch operations need add/remove/replace/move with explicit entity types rather than arbitrary json pointer danger. 13. patch apply must clone canonical state before changes. 14. patch history should store before/after or inverse operations for reliable undo/redo. 15. ai director accepts injected provider but deterministic fallback remains operational offline. 16. ai generated output must migrate, normalize and validate before manifestation. 17. revision provider should return patches, not uncontrolled complete state, when possible. 18. character continuity should inspect cast ids and scene references without depending on renderer rigs. 19. asset registry should tolerate url, local reference and generated placeholder sources. 20. adapter base should carry app id, capabilities and fidelity reporting. 21. every adapter must preserve the canonical movie alongside native projection. 22. compatibility adapters should re export canonical classes rather than duplicate behavior. 23. ui panels should communicate via callbacks/events, not import app globals. 24. timeline panel can start as semantic scene/shot cards while specialized nle surfaces keep advanced trims. 25. prompt panel must expose duration, mode, orientation and exact prompt text. 26. storyboard panel must show scene titles, timing and layer/camera summaries. 27. export panel should expose quality profiles and app handoff choices. 28. the shared canvas runtime should render new semantic caption/media/audio layers gracefully even when audio itself is nonvisual. 29. render profile should explicitly separate preview from final quality. 30. render manifest should include project fingerprint fields even if cryptographic hashing is injected later. 31. tests need zero external package assumptions where possible so node can run them directly. 32. browser proof should exercise a narrow mobile viewport and at least one director flow. 33. real media proof should use ffmpeg/ffprobe if present; otherwise browser frame evidence is insufficient for the original export requirement. 34. final completion must state any truly external future engine (cloud collaboration, full webgpu physics) as an extension boundary only if every local safe implementation path has been exhausted.
